description: POST /v0/analyze takes a local file as the multipart part `file` (`-F "file=@path_to_local_file"`) or a remote one as the `url` query parameter (`-G --data-urlencode "url=..."`) (https://www.tinybird.co/docs/api-reference/analyze-api); its section has no parameter table.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: A sample of a local CSV, NDJSON or Parquet file (multipart part `file`).
URL of a remote file to analyze.
